newsitem.title: USA: Wheeling-Pittsburgh to sell nail plant.
newsitem.headline: Wheeling-Pittsburgh to sell nail plant.

text.p: Wheeling-Pittsburgh Steel Corp said Friday it has tentatively agreed to sell the LaBelle Cut Nail Plant to D-Mac Industries Inc of Atlanta.
The WHX Corp subsidiary said no details were disclosed.
D-Mac Industries has indicated its intent to operate the plant in place, Wheeling-Pittsburgh said.
The steel company said it had given a time extension to the parties to allow for a successful negotiation of a labor agreement with the United Steelworkers of America.

"Wheeling-Pittsburgh Steel is gratified that its efforts to secure a buyer intent on continuing operations of the plant have been successful," chief executive John R. Scheessele said. The company announced in March its intention to sell or permanently shut down the Wheeling facility.
D-Mac is a company engaged in metal decking sales and construction services in the south. It had been a manufacturer's representative for cut nails.
